

# winver.exe is all Rust (winver-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/winver-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# osinfo.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/winver-rust/src/winver/osinfo.rs)
# winver.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/winver-rust/src/winver/winver.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(winver_res OBJECT winver.rc)
target_compile_definitions(winver_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(winver_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(winver winver-cargo winver.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE winver-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS winver_res)
